summary: Deliverable is incomplete per stated requirements. **Critical missing elements**: (1) No Pester test file; task explicitly required red/green TDD with failing tests first. (2) No fixture files (*.xml, *.json samples); workflow references 'fixtures/' but provides no sample data. (3) Workflow doesn't run tests; requirement stated 'ALL TESTS MUST RUN THROUGH ACT' but workflow has no test execution step. Scripts themselves are well-structured (Set-StrictMode, -LiteralPath, proper error handling, good separation: Invoke-Aggregator.ps1 → TestResultsAggregator.ps1), but lack of tests makes them fragile and untestable. Workflow YAML is sound (pinned refs, least-privilege) but can't run without fixtures; no validation that fixtures exist before aggregation. Markdown formatting has hardcoded strings (lines 114–121 of TestResultsAggregator.ps1) that could be constants. ConvertTo-TestResultRecord naming is a workaround (not ConvertTo- semantic), justified in comments but still a style violation.
